agenda_item: BOA-010: Monster of the Week — Automated Deep Research and Telegram Feature

fund_manager.cadence_recommendation: Hybrid — event-driven in Markup (fires when ticker first appears in candidates[]), weekly Sunday prep brief in Distribution/Sideways/Markdown
essential_content: Catalyst: what is changing NOW (the N in CAN SLIM)
Stage analysis: base number + distance from breakout
Bear case with specific price level where thesis is wrong
nice_to_have_content: Moat analysis (early-stage moat is thesis-based not proven)
Revenue inflection (ALREADY IN PIPELINE — just display it)
fund_manager.format: 3-message Telegram thread maximum. Message 1: setup. Message 2: thesis. Message 3: risk. A 5-10 minute read is a newsletter format not a Telegram format — reduce to 3-minute read.
fund_manager.frameworks: Primary: O'Neil N (what changed 6-18 months ago that institutions haven't priced in). Secondary: Druckenmiller asymmetry (max loss vs realistic upside). Supporting: Minervini base quality.
use_cases_ranked: 1. Conviction building before Mode B entry (prevents emotional stop-hit on first pullback)
2. Regime-change readiness (Distribution prep → act within hours when bigshot_ok flips True)
3. Watchlist prioritization (act of deep research implicitly deprioritizes other candidates)
4. Thesis tracking over time (institutional-quality research log, 52-week learning system)
5. Signal calibration education (reading own automated output teaches what system misses)
fund_manager.max_damage_scenario: Feature produces compelling brief for a Base 3 stock (heuristic estimation error). CIO places 5% Mode B entry. Stock fails at -10% stop. Damage: 0.5% of portfolio per event. Not catastrophic. Real risk: systematic over-weighting of narrative trains CIO to trust narrative over data. Guard: always display pipeline data as-is, not re-interpreted.
fund_manager.key_condition: Pipeline data (RS, base, inflection) displayed as-is from system — research agent adds narrative, does NOT recalculate

research.simplicity_test: PASS — one sentence: 'Every Sunday, AlphaAbsolute automatically picks the best Monster Scout candidate, researches it with web data, and sends a conviction brief to Telegram so the CIO is prepared to act if regime improves.'
research.practitioner_precedent: IBD Stock Spotlight format (strongest precedent). Published daily. Company story in 3-4 paragraphs. Key data: EPS/Rev growth, RS Rating, Accumulation/Distribution, base type, buy point. Direct model for this feature.
research.secondary_precedent: Minervini weekly chart analysis: Stage 2 + VCP base + volume. Very concise. O'Neil weekly Stock Spotlight: leadership in industry, new product, institutional support rising, base + buy point, stop loss level.
data_sources_available_now: candidates.json: breakout type, base count, theme grade, ADTV, conviction score, RS context
earnings_inflection.json: inflection label, revenue trend Q0-Q3, trend_str
data_sources_needing_new_calls: Company description: FMP /profile (1 call per ticker, free tier)
TAM estimate: web search required (BigData MCP or WebSearch)
Moat analysis: Claude judgment from web context

10x_research_protocol.oneil: Is there a New product/service with large TAM? Institutional sponsors accumulating? Industry in early S-curve? Company is the RS LEADER vs peers? Earnings acceleration confirmed (1-2 quarters)?
10x_research_protocol.minervini: Stage 2 with Trend Template? VCP/BKT base with volume dry-up? RS line at/near new highs? First 20-30% breakout from Base 1?
10x_research_protocol.druckenmiller: Macro tailwind identified? Probability-weighted 3-year return? Once-in-a-decade structural shift or cyclical? Price level where thesis is WRONG?
10x_research_protocol.lynch_category: Fast Grower (20-50% growth, small in large market) → 10-40x target. Turnaround (was losing, now positive) → 3-10x target.

quant.lead_time_quality: 7/10 — fires before entry (Sunday before Monday open). Weakness: in Distribution regime, no trade can be placed even after the brief.
quant.evidence_strength: 7/10 — strong practitioner precedent (IBD, Minervini). No internal backtest possible (N=0 Mode B trades). The research protocol (O'Neil N + Druckenmiller asymmetry) is well-documented.

base_rate_literature.minervini_vcp_hit_rate: 47-50% (multiple USIC interviews 2010-2014). BUT these are AFTER full Trend Template + VCP. Not just 3-month high.
base_rate_literature.oneil_pivot_success: ~30% produce 20%+ gains. ~50% fail and return to base within 8 weeks. 10x rate much lower.
base_rate_literature.bulkowski_3m_breakout: ~64% hit new 3M high within 3 months of breakout. ~25-35% fail within 5 weeks (Encyclopedia of Chart Patterns, 2005).
base_rate_literature.10x_specifically: No published estimate for 3M high + Base 0-1 + thematic → 10x rate. 3-5% of top decile momentum stocks produce 5-10x over 5 years (AQR/Morningstar). Correct framing: how many Mode B candidates produce >50% gain in 12 months?

quant.formula_flaw_identified: ADTV rewards large-cap stocks which anti-correlate with 10x probability. LRCX ($2.4B/day ADTV, large cap) ranks above RGTI ($660M ADTV, small cap) despite RGTI having far higher asymmetric return potential.
quant.formula_correction: Separate select_for_research() function (not changes to score_candidate()). Add: market_cap < $2B → +5pts, $2B-$10B → +3pts, >$10B → 0pts. Reduce ADTV max from 5pts to 2pts.
quant.additionality_verdict: YES — candidates.json is quantitative screening. The brief provides qualitative conviction (WHY company could 10x, WHAT would prove thesis wrong, WHERE in discovery arc). Qualitatively different. Both serve different purposes.
quant.backtest_gate: No standard N>=20 gate — informational feature only. Track quality via post-mortem linkage after N=10 briefs + N=5 closed Mode B trades. Selection formula must be transparent and versioned.
quant.selection_bias_note: Highest conviction_score is NOT the same as best opportunity. The formula optimizes for breakout quality (correct for trading) but misaligned for 10x probability (which favors small caps, early stage, high asymmetry).

pipeline_architecture.step1_selector: FEASIBLE — Easy. Read candidates.json, regime-aware logic, 50 lines. Edge: scores show 20.0 due to rs=0 bug (BOA-005-BUG-05 fixed, regenerates on next run). Interim: use raw components not total score.
pipeline_architecture.step2_research_agent: FEASIBLE — Medium. Claude Sonnet with web search. Cost ~$0.05-$0.15/week = $5-8/year. Prompt engineering required. Structured JSON output.
pipeline_architecture.step3_telegram_formatter: FEASIBLE — Easy. 2-3 messages (4096 char limit each). Reuse send_telegram() from report_writer.py.
pipeline_architecture.step4_push: ALREADY WORKING — send_telegram() in report_writer.py. No new script needed.

component_complexity.research_agent: Medium — 150-200 lines, prompt engineering, error handling
component_complexity.scheduling: Easy — day-of-week check inside existing runner (Option A recommended)
component_complexity.error_handling: Medium — 5 failure modes, each needs graceful fallback

Earnings gate check not in current pipeline — must be added to formatter (flag not block)

edge_cases.no_candidates_this_week: Send 'Market Watch' brief — top 3 from watch_queue with regime note. Always useful.
edge_cases.earnings_in_3_days: DO NOT block brief. Flag prominently: 'EARNINGS IN 3 DAYS — wait for print or size 2.5%.'
edge_cases.web_search_no_results: Fallback to structured data only. Label: 'Research limited — manual review recommended.'
edge_cases.telegram_push_fails: Write to data/bigshot/motw_[date].json anyway. Retry once after 60 seconds.
edge_cases.markdown_regime: Run brief, label 'MARKDOWN REGIME — research only, no entries.'

da.scheduling_recommendation: Option A — day-of-week check inside pre_market_runner.py. Sunday 6AM Bangkok = Saturday 23:00 UTC. MOTW step runs after A07 Monster Scout step, only when weekday()==6 OR (new_markup_candidate detected).

vote_summary.vote_type: Standard signal vote (3/4 threshold). All 4 voted conditional approve. No wing vetoes triggered.

conditions_summary: 1. Hybrid cadence: event-driven in Markup, weekly Sunday prep in Distribution/Sideways/Markdown
2. 3-message Telegram format (not 5-8). Message 1: setup. Message 2: thesis. Message 3: risk.
3. Pipeline data displayed as-is — research agent adds narrative, does NOT recalculate
4. Bear case must include specific price/fundamental triggers (not generic)
5. Separate select_for_research() with market cap inverse weighting (small cap bonus)
6. Regime-aware selector (watch_queue in Distribution, candidates[] in Markup)
7. Earnings flag in formatter if earnings within 7 days (flag not block)
8. Fallback mechanism if research agent or web search fails
